outcomeNote: A mishna stating law. No party transmits, interprets, questions or opposes another, so no interactions are emitted; the reasons are deferred to the gemara.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נָשִׁים וַעֲבָדִים וּקְטַנִּים פְּטוּרִין מִקְּרִיאַת שְׁמַע
segments.en: MISHNA «Women, slaves, and minors,» who have parallel obligations in various mitzvot, «are exempt from the recitation of Shema»

segments.he: וּמִן הַתְּפִילִּין, וְחַיָּיבִין בִּתְפִילָּה וּבִמְזוּזָה וּבְבִרְכַּת הַמָּזוֹן.
segments.en: «and from phylacteries, but» they «are obligated in» the mitzvot of «prayer, mezuza, and Grace after Meals.» The Gemara explains the rationale for these exemptions and obligations.

moves.cueHe: נשים ועבדים וקטנים פטורין מקריאת שמע
moves.summary: the mishna exempts women, slaves and minors from the recitation of Shema

moves.cueHe: ומן התפילין, וחייבין בתפילה ובמזוזה ובברכת המזון
moves.summary: and from phylacteries, while obligating them in prayer, mezuza and Grace after Meals
